description.narrative: This allocation contributes to meeting the objectives of UNICEF’s response in Syria to provide access to clean water, sanitation, health services and education, targeting 7,9 million beneficiaries, especially children

This allocation of 11 million DKK to UNICEF contributes to meeting the objectives of the UNICEF Syrian Arab Republic Appeal for 2022. Humanitarian needs have increased by more than one quarter since 2020. More than 13.4 million people require assistance and 7 million people are internally displaced. In 2022, UNICEF will deliver life-saving services to children and families, including through a multi-sector resilience-building approach with its partners and field offices.
This allocation contributes to meeting the objectives of UNICEF’s response in Syria to provide access to clean water, sanitation, health services and education, targeting 7,9 million beneficiaries, especially children.
Due to its nature as a response to a humanitarian appeal operational results are general and highly aggregated and the MFA contribution is thus reflected in the overall results reporting by the partner. Please refer to the hyperlink below.
https://www.unicef.org/research-and-reports
